# Pending-task applicability and supported continuation

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

For every stock, a course of draws is executable exactly when each draw is within the stock then standing. Review draws one unit of work and action two, so the review-and-action course is covered exactly from three current units, and an endpoint completes its review and action exactly when the report clears the relevant risk and its work covers that course; refusal or exhaustion retains the unfinished task and the work already used. Loss through review: for every condition, report and pending endpoint, a review adds one loss exactly when the report clears the relevant risk, the work covers that course and the delivered practice’s relevant risk, its outcome law’s loss condition, actually holds; every review whose report does not clear the relevant risk keeps the loss count (an instance of the gated-change law), and so does every course of such reviews. So a covered report, one covering effect-time conditions, prevents added represented practice loss. Relevant-condition review, using one unit of work, consumes the actually delivered revision. The protocol itself supplies the two outcome laws and so which risk is relevant. The learning branch admits changes to the other two context fields; action protection does not imply continued comparative warrant.

Canonical source: [PendingTaskApplicability.lean](../../../../experiments/market-generativity/meta-attractor/PendingTaskApplicability.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- Inherited two-practice outcome law, acquired goal state, versioned route and synchronized authorized rewrite; G0/J and report correspondence remain explicit.
- Review consumes one work unit and starting action needs two; the report covers relevant conditions at the actual effect. Review/action is a local abstract step, without a physical exclusion or sensor implementation.
- The completion instance supplies one additional current work unit initially, total 19; it neither freely converts reserve nor derives real provision.

Acquisition, delivery, review and effect are differentiated relations in one common activity. Relevance follows from the supplied outcome law, without defining unseen relations as irrelevant; acquisition and change of that law remain to explain.

<a id="检验与边界-validation-and-boundaries"></a>
## Validation and boundaries

Lean 4.30.0-rc2 checked 14 new theorems/22 new audits, separately from 205 inherited theorems/354 inherited audits. Repository imports rebuilt; upstream cache pinned. No empirical validation or independent acceptance. General laws: checker receipts bound.

Covers only two practice protections in the supplied outcome law. Report formation, acquisition/revision of relevance, waiting consequences and actual continuation of unmet needs are unproved. Correctness at sampling does not ensure effect coverage; no universal societal degeneration or complete corrigibility theorem.

- check_can_exhaust_action_support retains exhaustion after review; safe_change_can_remove_comparative_warrant separates action protection from comparison; report_not_covering_effect_can_still_fail retains loss when the report fails to cover the effect.
